sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – proposal for full allocation, 2027–2028
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation offer:70410-0. We would like to propose a complete package: EUR 30.28/unit, 23,400 units/year, 24 months, 56 days lead time. Payment stays at 30 days, delivery DAP, effective 2027-01-01.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31 per unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010). We do not claim this is your actual cost.
LCI-C rose 2.66% from June 2025 to June 2026 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
PPI-C2219 rose 3.90% from August 2025 to August 2026 (idx:PPI-C2219@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-08).

We recognise these input cost increases and your capacity constraint. Our proposal is therefore above our current EUR 29.89. In return for full allocation at this price, we offer a binding two-year commitment for the full volume. We also accept the 56-day lead time to support your scheduling.

Could this package work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – proposal for full allocation, 2027–2028
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Furthermore, the indices you cite do not reflect our specific production realities. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We can accommodate your requested volume of 23,400 units over 24 months with a 56-day lead time. For this package, our price is EUR 31.90 per unit. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
